title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "T"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: storm-plot
storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  distinct(year, name, status) |>
  count(year, status) |>
  complete(year, status, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  mutate(status = factor(
    status,
    levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"),
    labels = c("Tropical Depression", "Tropical Storm", "Hurricane")
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.85, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Tropical Depression" = "lightblue",
      "Tropical Storm" = "orange",
      "Hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Storm Counts by Type per Year",
    subtitle = "Annual counts of tropical depressions, tropical storms, and hurricanes",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: storms_recent
#| cache: true
storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-wind-pressure
ggplot(storms_recent, aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Wind Speed and Air Pressure in Atlantic Storms",
    subtitle = "Stronger storms combine faster winds with lower pressure",
    x = "Wind Speed (knots)",
    y = "Air Pressure (millibars)",
    color = "Status"
  )
```
